terms.summary: Free to download and use; the library itself may not be redistributed or sold. Commercial use of the UTAU library needs separate permission first. Credit is not required.

Songs made with it may be shared and released, commercially too; label them as AI-synthesised and credit "Qixuan" and "DiffSinger". The voicebank may not be sold, and its output may not be used to train other voice models. The Chinese terms prevail.
